text.en:
The sum of two million five hundred thousand pesos (P2,500,00.00) is hereby appropriated as
operating funds of the Task Force on Human Settlements out of any funds in the National Treasury not
otherwise appropriated .

This decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 26th day of February, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-four.
